author: Ajnas N B
purpose: Cross-harness integration smoke and focused source-component checks; not a security certification or benchmark ranking

claude_code.source_visibility: commercial CLI; inspect MIT SDK separately

tool_policy: No built-in host shell or arbitrary file tools. Narrow study_read_file, study_write_file and study_run_public_tests via MCP/custom-tool broker. Host-owned assessor after candidate seal.
claims: Fresh conversations and workspaces; saved model requests, CLI output, broker events, hashes and independent results.
Codex/OpenHands/Delta use GPT-6.1 Sol, but system prompts/loop behavior are native and differ.
Claude Code uses its supported Claude model; a difference cannot be attributed only to its harness.
Six trajectories per engine establish integration feasibility only.
Upstream SDK tests do not establish coding-agent security.
No remote repo, branch, commit, or push.
